about: The truth per answer for the theme counts of the course evaluation (evals/evaluation-jev/README.md). Written once, before any measurement, from the text of the answers alone. `lines` follows the non-empty lines of the survey: per answer, the themes it makes. `from` reuses a case of evals/course-evaluation/cases.json; the other cases are complete here.
